about: The model-neutral training spec for a LoRA adapter on verified decisions (adapters/README.md; checked by scripts/lib/learning/adapter.js validateSpec). The dataset builder (scripts/decision-dataset.js build) balances by it and reports its coverage gaps against `coverage`; the structure-read builder (scripts/structure-read-dataset.js) balances by `structureRead`; an adapter's manifest is checked against it.
